items.title: Is RTX (RTX) Undervalued As Its $22.9 Billion Missile Contract Expands Backlog?
items.summary: RTX (RTX) is back in focus after its Raytheon business received a US$22.9b, seven year contract from the U.S. military to ramp Tomahawk missile production from 60 to 1,000 units annually. RTX shares trade at US$212.08 after a strong run, with an 18.05% 90-day share price return and a 13.26% year-to-date share price return. The 1-year total shareholder return of 33.96% points to momentum that aligns with these recent contract wins and capacity expansions. Spot 92 nuclear energy infrastructure...
